set.rappel_count_note: Five stations is the double-rope count. Ultramega OK has no rappel line of its own - it is a Northeast Buttress route that merges into upper North Face terrain, and parties take the North Face descent. The same ground is 9-10 rappels for a party doing many shorter ones on a single rope, and a two-60 party describes it as a doubled first rappel, one single rappel to the ledge at the bottom of pitch 3, then three more double rappels to Burgundy Col - all three counts describe one descent under different rope setups. Rope opinion is genuinely split rather than settled: two ropes are quicker, but a first-hand account calls double ropes here annoying and prone to sticking and prefers a single 70 m, and a single 60 m does not reach the only bolted anchor on the route. The approximate lengths, about 40, 55, 55, 40 and 60 m, come from the North Face descent description.
set.rappels: 5 double-rope rappels down the North Face rappel line to Burgundy Col; 9-10 shorter rappels on a single rope
